paragraph: On 4 December 2025 [an executive decree stated that the Guiché Único da Empresa runs an online company-incorporation system with national reach](<https://lex.ao/docs/ministerio-da-justica-e-dos-direitos-humanos/2025/decreto-executivo-n-o-734-25-de-04-de-dezembro/>). Online incorporation dates from 2020, when [an executive decree entered into force carrying company incorporation and registration certificates online at www.gue.gov.ao](<https://www.iflr.com/article/2gjw2n5ocpr2orkl4miq9/iflr1000/angola-regulations-on-online-commercial-registration-and-publications>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says registration gives a firm one number shared with tax or social security. None says the register collects beneficial owners. Operating would need registration to give a firm one number shared with the tax authority or social security.

In July 2024 the Agence de Développement du Burundi [described company and sole-trader registration done online through the easybusiness.bi platform](<https://investburundi.bi/procedure-de-la-creation/>). A 2026 project page says the agency, with UNCTAD and the World Bank Group, launched Easybusiness.bi, which [is a fully online single-window platform for business registration](<https://www.businessfacilitation.org/academy/projects/burundi/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says registration gives a firm one number shared with tax or social security. Operating would need registration to give a firm one number shared with the tax authority or social security.

In March 2020 [the government said online company creation was effective on monentreprise.bj through APIEx](<https://www.gouv.bj/article/534/investir-au-benin-les-facilites-de-creation-dentreprise-exposees-aux-acteurs-du-prive/>). [APIEx's guide says companies are registered in the RCCM entirely online through www.monentreprise.bj](<https://monentreprise.bj/APIEX_Guide_pratique_v2_3e1993847e.pdf>). The guide lists the certificates issued: an RCCM extract, an attestation for the IFU tax identifier and a notice of the CNSS employer number. That is three documents, and no single shared number. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Nothing found says the register collects beneficial owners. Operating would need registration to give a firm one number shared with the tax authority or social security.

On 15 December 2025 the Ministry of Justice [launched the e-RCCM platform](<https://burkina24.com/2025/12/15/justice-et-transformation-numerique-le-burkina-faso-passe-a-la-vitesse-superieure-avec-un-triple-lancement/>), which issues register extracts, registration certificates and non-bankruptcy certificates online. [CEFORE's portal, creerentreprise.me.bf, takes business-creation requests online](<https://creerentreprise.me.bf/>). It takes fees by Orange Money or Moov Money. It reports 6,916 requests from 1 January to 13 November 2026. Both date from the last twelve months, and no earlier position has been found. No source found since October 2023 says registration gives a firm one number shared with tax or social security. Operating would need registration to give a firm one number shared with the tax authority or social security.

In February 2025 [CIPA said its Online Business Registration System, acquired in 2019, lets investors register companies online 24/7 and cut registration from over five days to one](<https://businessweekly.co.bw/news/cipa-rots-from-the-head-splashes-p15m-on-bad-it-system>). Before it, CIPA said, it relied on a semi-automated process with no online functionality. The same report puts the system's cost at the centre of a dispute over its performance. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Nothing found says registration gives a firm one number shared with tax or social security. Nothing found says the register collects beneficial owners in service. Operating would need registration to give a firm one number shared with the tax authority or social security.

On 2 February 2026 GUFE RCA [opened its third one-stop company counter at Berberati, after Bangui and Bambari](<https://gufe-rca.org/antenne-gufe-berberati-operationnelle/>), offering company creation, modification and dissolution on the spot. In May 2026 the counter [launched a website with World Bank support, while still working largely by hand](<https://lengosongo.cf/2026/05/14/centrafrique-le-gufe-rca-lance-un-site-internet-pour-moderniser-la-creation-dentreprises/>). Both date from the last twelve months, and no earlier position has been found. No source found since October 2023 says firms can register online. Establishing would need online business registration in service.

[CEPICI says the Identifiant Unique, in use since 2018, is now the one number a firm needs with every administration](<https://cepici.africa/reforme>). With it a firm is registered at once with the commercial register, the tax authority and the social security fund CNPS. [In July 2025 CEPICI launched a directory of registered firms keyed on that number](<https://news.abidjan.net/articles/743032/environnement-des-affaires-le-cepici-lance-lannuaire-idu-un-registre-des-entreprises-ivoiriennes>). [In mid-July 2026 its director general put the average time to create a company online at 2.4 days](<https://connectionivoirienne.net/2026/08/11/cote-divoire-le-delai-de-creation-dentreprise-en-ligne-ramene-a-24-jours-annonce-la-dg-du-cepici/>). That figure dates from the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the register collects beneficial owners. Mature would need the register to hold the beneficial owners of every company in the country, and a firm's number shared with tax or social security.

In April 2024 OHADA [reported an AFD-financed project to computerise the national commerce and movable credit register (RCCM) in Cameroon](<https://www.ohada.org/informatisation-du-rccm-cameroun-les-parties-prenantes-font-le-point/>). The project also covers 30 sites, the greffes and business formality centres. Equipment had been acquired, sites wired and users trained, and official handover to the state was planned for June 2024. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says firms can register online. Establishing would need online business registration in service.

In 2026 ACTUALITE.CD reported that the Guichet Unique de Création d'Entreprise (GUCE) [presented a new website that proposes a legal form and tracks a file in real time](<https://actualite.cd/2026/07/28/formalisation-des-entreprises-en-rdc-daniel-mukoko-samba-mise-sur-le-numerique-pour>). [Firms still register at the counter in person; the TRANSFORME project targets online registration for 2027](<https://www.transforme.cd/activities/formaliser-son-entreprise-plus-pres-et-bientot-en-ligne-grace-au-projet-transforme>). Both date from the last twelve months, and no earlier position has been found. No source found since October 2023 says firms can register online. Establishing would need online business registration in service.

On 5 December 2025 the minister for small and medium enterprises [launched an online company-creation platform in Brazzaville, at www.acpce.cg](<https://labreveonline.com/lancement-dune-plateforme-de-creation-dentreprise-en-ligne-au-congo/>). [The platform is 100 percent online: entrepreneurs file, track and pay fees there](<https://24newsagency.com/brazzaville-lancement-officiel-de-la-plateforme-de-creation-dentreprises-en-ligne-du-ministere-des-pme-et-de-lartisana/>). [More than 5,300 firms were created in 2025](<https://24newsagency.com/brazzaville-lancement-officiel-de-la-plateforme-de-creation-dentreprises-en-ligne-du-ministere-des-pme-et-de-lartisana/>). The launch dates from the last twelve months, and no earlier position has been found. No source found since October 2023 says registration gives a firm one number shared with tax or social security. Operating would need registration to give a firm one number shared with the tax authority or social security.

In January 2026 the national investment promotion agency, ANPI, was [about to launch the Guichet générique diaspora](<https://www.comoresinfos.net/bientot-depuis-letranger-la-diaspora-pourra-ouvrir-son-entreprise-aux-comores/>), built with the French development agency and Expertise France. It is meant to let Comorians abroad assemble a company file and send documents online. The official signing of the deeds and entry in the commercial register still take place in person in the Comoros. This dates from the last twelve months, and no earlier position has been found. No source found says firms can register fully online. Establishing would need online business registration in service.

In March 2024 Lusa [reported a government tender for an internet portal covering the whole life cycle of a company](<https://www.balai.cv/noticias/atualidade/cabo-verde-prepara-portal-para-criacao-de-empresas-na-internet/>). In the last twelve months, in April 2026, Portaria 33/2026 [set fees for incorporating, amending and dissolving companies electronically](<https://boe.incv.cv/Bulletins/DownloadAct?id=100739>), paid only online through the single Plataforma Empresa Online. [In 2026 the platform's package covered the commercial registry, a tax number (NIF) and social security (INPS)](<https://peo.gov.cv/sobre-nos>), all in one process. No source found since October 2023 says registration gives one shared number. Operating would need registration to give a firm one number shared with the tax authority or social security.

In April 2018 [Decree 2018-146 made the ANPI one-stop shop the sole place for company creation](<https://www.journalofficiel.dj/texte-juridique/decret-n2018-146-pr-mapci-portant-reglementation-des-formalites-de-creation-dentreprises/>). In the last twelve months, [the Prime Minister says a person can create a company entirely online on the platform launched on 26 January 2026](<https://primature.gouv.dj/discours-du-premier-ministre-9/>). [The entreprendre.dj guide says it takes 72 hours and costs 23,000 FDJ](<https://entreprendre.dj/portals/g2b/guide>). No source found since October 2023 says registration gives a firm one number shared with tax or social security. Operating would need registration to give a firm one number shared with the tax authority or social security.

In 2026 [the CNRC said the single registration gives the firm a common identification number](<https://sidjilcom-entreprise.cnrc.dz/acceuil>). It is issued within three days of approval by CNRC, the tax directorate (DGI), CNAS, CASNOS and ONS. [A firm can register in the commerce register online through its company-creation portal](<https://sidjilcom-entreprise.cnrc.dz/creation-d-entreprise-personne-morale>). Fees are paid by CIB or Edahabia card. These statements date from the last twelve months, and no earlier position has been found. No source found since October 2023 says the register collects beneficial owners. Mature would need the register to hold the beneficial owners of every company in the country, and a firm's number shared with tax or social security.

From 3 August 2025 [all limited liability companies are incorporated only on the GAFI electronic portal](<https://gate.ahram.org.eg/News/5259847.aspx>). [In September 2023 GAFI launched its Company e-Incorporation Service](<https://gafi.gov.eg/en/contenttemplate/ca1b9d8b-76d1-46dc-a677-eb4ba5ccaae3>). [In July 2025 six services were added to the Digital Egypt platform](<https://www.businessmen-eg.com/en/2088/itda-launches-online-tax-number-verification-for-commercial-registry>), bringing online Commercial Registry services to 20. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says registration gives a firm one number shared with tax or social security. Operating would need registration to give a firm one number shared with the tax authority or social security.

In September 2025 the Ministry of Trade and Regional Integration, with GIZ, [launched the Integrated Company Creation Journey](<https://birrmetrics.com/motri-launches-online-business-registration-and-licensing-platform/>), a fully digital system. It cut 11 steps over 32 days to two steps in two days. In the last twelve months, in June 2026, [the ministry moved import-export registration to the Online Trade Registration and Licensing System](<https://birrmetrics.com/import-export-licensing-centralized-as-government-targets-regional-loopholes/>). The system links 745 registration offices. In October 2026 [the ministry reported 60,409 new business registrations in three months](<https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_9819771>). No source found since October 2023 says registration gives a firm one number shared with tax or social security. Operating would need registration to give a firm one number shared with the tax authority or social security.

No stage is set. Nothing found since October 2023 says whether firms can register online in Gabon. Nothing found says a digital business register has been procured, that its records are being digitised, or that a one-stop registration counter has opened. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Absent would need a source from the past three years that says business registration is on paper and held locally.

In July 2026 Registrar-General officials told AmCham Ghana that [an end-to-end online business registration platform was being piloted](<https://amchamghana.org/2026/07/23/amcham-ghana-engages-registrar-general-on-digital-transformation-and-business-registration-reforms/>), from name search to certificate. A year earlier [the acting Registrar of Companies said the office was testing a platform for registering businesses remotely](<https://gna.org.gh/2025/08/orc-to-implement-key-reforms-toreset-ghanas-business-environment/>) and aimed to roll it out by the end of 2025. In the last twelve months it stayed a pilot. [EITI says 175,984 companies had filed beneficial ownership data with the Office of the Registrar of Companies by 30 September 2025](<https://eiti.org/impact-story/ghana-unlocking-ownership-data-accountability-extractive-sector>). Nothing found says the beneficial owners of every company are recorded. Establishing would need online business registration in service.

In March 2026 Judicalex, which operates the Conakry commercial court's digitisation platform, said [digitisation projects for the RCCM and other requests are in development for the coming months](<https://judicalex-gn.org/blog/post/tribunal-du-commerce-le-ministre-de-la-justice-ibrahima-sory-2-tounkara-decouvre-les-installations-de-judicalex/>). [APIP-Guinee says it is digitalising company-creation procedures](<https://apip.gov.gn/apip-guinee-digitalisation-des-services-renforcement-des-capacites/>), with a new version of the SYNERGUI2 platform linked to the tax system SAFIG2. Both date from the last twelve months, and no earlier position has been found. No source found since October 2023 says firms can register online. Establishing would need online business registration in service.

In August 2026 Minister Ceesay [said the government is finalising the Digital Single Window Business Registration System](<https://thepoint.gm/africa/gambia/headlines/trans-gambia-economic-zone-set-to-create-3400-jobs-as-investor-interest-grows>), meant to simplify registration. In 2026 [the Single Window Registry portal listed digital services for registering a sole proprietorship, company, partnership, external company and non-profit](<https://easybusiness.gov.gm/>), but that listing is dated only to the year. Both date from the last twelve months, and no earlier position has been found. No source found since October 2023 says firms can register online in service. Establishing would need online business registration in service.

Between 2010 and 2012 presidential and government decrees [formally established the Centro de Formalização de Empresas on the one-stop model](<https://cfe.gw/sobre-nos/>). Its own page says online company registration is still only planned. The centre's [company-creation platform](<https://cfegb.com/>) now takes founders' files online or through an agent, and counts more than 7,666 firms created. Validation and payment happen at the counter. The platform dates from the last twelve months. Nothing found says registration gives a firm one number shared with the tax authority or social security. Operating would need registration to give a firm one number shared with the tax authority or social security.

In July 2024 Real Equatorial Guinea [reported the commerce minister demanding faster incorporation at the Ventanilla Unica Empresarial](<https://realequatorialguinea.com/destacado/politica/gobierno-muestra-su-descontento-por-la-tardanza-para-crear-una-empresa-en-la-ventanilla-unica-empresarial/>), the country's one-stop company-creation counter. The minister asked for incorporation in three days at most. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says firms can register online. Establishing would need online business registration in service.

On 16 February 2026 the Business Registration Service [launched a second version of its portal on eCitizen for company changes](<https://www.kenyans.co.ke/news/120891-huduma-kenya-clarifies-end-physical-business-certificates-after-ecitizen-integration>), and [downloadable certificates replaced paper ones](<https://www.kenyans.co.ke/news/120891-huduma-kenya-clarifies-end-physical-business-certificates-after-ecitizen-integration>). [Its partners page, as captured in June 2026, lists an online Beneficial Ownership Information Register for private companies as operational](<https://brs.go.ke/development-partners/>). These date from the last twelve months, and no earlier position has been found. No source found since October 2023 says registration gives a firm one number shared with tax or social security. Nothing found says the beneficial owners of every company are recorded. Operating would need registration to give a firm one number shared with the tax authority or social security.

In August 2026 the Ministry of Commerce, through the Liberia Business Registry, [launched a business registration digitalisation and decentralisation project in Ganta, Nimba County](<https://dnnewsliberia.com/liberia-business-registry-launches-digitalization-and-decentralization-project-in-nimba/>), piloted in seven counties. The ministry says full digital filing will follow, so firms need not travel to Monrovia. Later that month the deputy commerce minister [listed online business registration among the reforms of the Liberia Investment, Finance and Trade Project](<https://liberianinvestigator.com/liberia-digital-collateral-registry-business-credit/>). Both date from the last twelve months, and no earlier position has been found. No source found says online business registration is in service. Establishing would need online business registration in service.

In February 2023 [a UNCTAD-built e-single window for company registration was being developed](<https://libyaherald.com/2023/02/commercial-registry-and-general-information-authority-receive-unctad-training-on-digital-transformation>). In July 2026 [the head of the Commercial Registry Authority said the plan was still being completed](<https://lana.gov.ly/post.php?id=361401&lang=ar>), linking all regional branches electronically. In November 2026 the Ministry of Economy and Trade [began a pilot of electronic registration for branches of foreign companies](<https://www.alwasat.ly/news/485008>), with full operation to follow. Both 2026 reports date from the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says firms can register online. Establishing would need online business registration in service.

In November 2025 CAFI's managing director, Chaba Mokuku, [spoke on a Business Facilitation Single Window](<https://lestimes.com/?p=89016>) deployed at the One Stop Business Facilitation Centre. It is to simplify registration and licensing, and was due to launch by early 2026. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says firms can register online, that registration gives a firm one number shared with tax or social security, or that the register collects beneficial owners. Establishing would need online business registration in service.

In March 2025 [OMPIC said its electronic company-creation platform was in service nationwide](<http://www.ompic.ma/fr/actualites/ompic-generalisation-de-la-plateforme-de-creation-dentreprises-par-voie-electronique-sur>). Over 12,000 firms had been created electronically since the Rabat pilot of February 2023. In 2016 [OMPIC said the Identifiant Commun de l'Entreprise (ICE) is one number used by all administrations](<http://www.ompic.ma/fr/content/identifiant-commun-de-lentreprise>). It has been mandatory on official documents since 1 July 2016. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says registration gives a firm one number shared with tax or social security. Operating would need registration to give a firm one number shared with the tax authority or social security.

[The head of the EDBM antenna in Manakara says the online company-creation platform Orinasa has been accessible there since July 2025](<https://newsmada.com/2026/05/26/investissement-prive-ledbm-sinstalle-a-manakara/>). [The tax directorate (DGI) launched its Registre Central des Beneficiaires Effectifs (RCBE) on 16 June 2026](<http://central.mef.gov.mg/page_personnalisee/index/news/1781>). On 18 September 2026 [the DGI signed four data-sharing protocols](<https://www.2424.mg/transparence-le-rcbe-entre-dans-sa-phase-dexploitation-avec-le-croisement-des-donnees>), one of which lets the RCBE be cross-matched with the trade and companies register. These 2026 events date from the last twelve months. The beneficial-owner register is the tax directorate's, kept apart from the business register. Nothing found says registration gives a firm one number shared with tax or social security. Operating would need registration to give a firm one number shared with the tax authority or social security.

In 2025 [API-Mali said its Guichet Unique brings company registration, operating authorisations and Investment Code approvals together in one place](<https://apimali.gov.ml/en/creation-entreprise/>). In July 2026 [Moctar Ousmane Sy wrote that firms can pre-register online there and upload scanned documents](<https://croissanceafrique.com/mali-cette-belle-proposition-citoyenne-de-moctar-ousmane-sy-pour-la-digitalisation-des-services-publics/>), but must still go to Bamako in person to file originals, pay and collect official documents. In November 2026 the justice minister said [a digital platform for the trade and personal-property credit register was nearly complete](<https://aesnews.com/mali-ejustice-requetes-verdicts-en-ligne/>). The last two reports date from the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says firms can register online. Establishing would need online business registration in service.

In November 2023 [Kabum Digital reported that the registry and notary service (SRN) launched an online platform](<https://kabum.digital/mocambique-lanca-plataforma-para-registo-de-empresas/>). Companies can be registered remotely and pay by M-Pesa or bank. [A 2024 decree-law requires legal entities to register owners of 10 percent or more](<https://www.rsm.global/mozambique/en/news/registo-do-beneficiario-efectivo>). Filing is online on the same portal and completed in person. In the last twelve months, in September 2026, [the BAU one-stop centre had 129 service points](<https://360mozambique.com/business/facim-2026-bau-pushes-digitalisation-to-ease-small-business-formalisation/>). No source found since October 2023 says registration gives a firm one number shared with tax or social security. Operating would need registration to give a firm one number shared with the tax authority or social security.

On 4 April 2025 [the ministers launched the investment agency APIM's digital services](<https://ami.mr/fr/archives/268316>), and investors can create companies online through the Mes services portal. [Company creation through the portal yields a commerce register entry, a tax registration and social security (CNSS) affiliation in a single procedure](<https://ami.mr/fr/archives/268316>). The source does not say the three registrations share one number. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Nothing found says the register collects beneficial owners. Operating would need registration to give a firm one number shared with the tax authority or social security.

[CBRD's annual report counts 8,565 companies incorporated online in 2024/25](<https://mof.govmu.org/Documents/2026/Annual%20Report%20on%20Performance%20for%20Ministries%20and%20Department/7-5%20CBRD/Annual%20report%2024%2025.pdf>), and says that in July 2024 868 were incorporated online against 318 at the office. [The department's April 2025 online guide describes incorporating companies and registering businesses through online forms](<https://companies.govmu.org/cbrd/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/GUIDELINES-FOR-INCORPORATION-REGISTRATION-OF-COMPANIES-AND-REGISTRATION-OF-BUSINESSES_04_04_25.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says registration gives a firm one number shared with tax or social security. Operating would need registration to give a firm one number shared with the tax authority or social security.

[President Chakwera launched the system on 29 February 2024](<https://www.247malawi.com/chakwera-launches-land-and-business-systems-a-leap-forward-in-governance/>), to streamline registration. [The Minister of Justice said in May 2026 that the Malawi Business Registration System lets firms register and keep their records online](<https://mwnation.com/minister-of-justice-urges-professionalism/>). In the last twelve months, in November 2026, [the registration centre required firms registered before its online portal to re-register on it](<https://malawi24.com/2026/11/16/businesses-face-december-31-deadline/>) by 31 December. No source found since October 2023 says registration gives a firm one number shared with tax or social security. Operating would need registration to give a firm one number shared with the tax authority or social security.

In 2024 the Business and Intellectual Property Authority (BIPA) [took company forms on paper at its offices](<https://www.bipa.na/business-registration/>), and fetched records from off-site storage in three to five days. In the last twelve months, in December 2025, it [announced a N$40 million registration platform built by CSS-CA Technology](<https://theissue.com.na/namibia-wallows-in-digital-sovereignty-illusion/>). In January 2026 BIPA [held the kick-off meeting with the developer](<https://www.linkedin.com/posts/business-and-intellectual-property-authority-bipa_ibrs-bipa-innovation-activity-7419737447879602177-EQNb>), aiming for incorporation within 60 minutes. Nothing found says the platform is live. Establishing would need online business registration in service.

In February 2026 the Registrar-General said [the Corporate Affairs Commission runs a fully digital, end-to-end registry open around the clock, receiving close to 10,000 registration requests a day](<https://punchng.com/cac-processes-10000-daily-registrations-after-ai-rollout/>). [Registrar-General Hussaini Magaji says Nigeria operates a CAC beneficial ownership register, with free access to the data](<https://von.gov.ng/cac-seeks-unified-beneficial-ownership-register/>). [The OGP Independent Reporting Mechanism says Nigeria launched its Beneficial Ownership Register in 2023](<https://www.opengovpartnership.org/documents/nigeria-results-report-2023-2025/>). The 2026 statements date from the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says registration gives a firm one number shared with tax or social security. Operating would need registration to give a firm one number shared with the tax authority or social security.

In 2026 [the Rwanda Revenue Authority says the RDB and RRA systems are integrated](<https://www.rra.gov.rw/en/domestic-tax-services/registration-de-registration/default-title>), so registration gives a single, unique Taxpayer Identification Number. [The Rwanda Development Board's Office of the Registrar General says business registration is 100% an online process and free of charge](<https://org.rdb.rw/business-registration/>). Both statements date from the last twelve months, and no earlier position has been found. No source found since October 2023 says the register collects beneficial owners. Mature would need the register to hold the beneficial owners of every company in the country, and a firm's number shared with tax or social security.

In October 2026 Sudan Dawn [reported that company-register and business-name transactions at the commercial registry are filed through the Baladna platform](<https://sudandawn.com/?p=22515>). [Lawyers said a technical fault had stalled them almost entirely for more than a week](<https://sudandawn.com/?p=22515>). The report dates from the last twelve months, and no earlier position has been found. No source found since October 2023 says registration gives a firm one number shared with tax or social security. None says the register collects beneficial owners. Operating would need registration to give a firm one number shared with the tax authority or social security.

In January 2025 the Economy Minister [inaugurated a digital platform for obtaining the NINEA](<https://www.wearetech.africa/en/fils-uk/news/public-management/senegal-launches-new-platform-to-streamline-business-registration>), to speed up business registration. In the last twelve months, on 10 November 2026, [the Justice Minister agreed to deploy the agency's digital company-creation platform in the courts](<https://fr.apanews.net/technologies/senegal-la-justice-accelere-la-digitalisation-des-entreprises/>). [EITI's country page, updated in 2026, says the commercial register records beneficial ownership information](<https://eiti.org/countries/senegal>). [The latest registry extract it cites covered 262 companies](<https://eiti.org/countries/senegal>). No source found since October 2023 says registration gives a firm one number shared with tax or social security. Operating would need registration to give a firm one number shared with the tax authority or social security.

In May 2026 Parliament [ratified a 15-year concession for a private firm to build and run the online registration system](<https://sierraloaded.sl/news/parliament-online-business-registration/>). On 10 November 2026 President Bio [launched the National Investment Board's Online Business Registration System](<https://www.ecofinagency.com/news-digital/1111-60716-sierra-leone-digitizes-business-registration-as-75-of-firms-remain-unregistered>).
